ns2:course.label: Modeling Natural Resources
ns2:course.description: Examines basic modeling concepts and methods. Modeling skills, model development, and natural resource issues and problems will be emphasized. Content areas include fisheries, forests, wildlife, economics, human dimensions, groundwater and surface water. Prerequisite: One of MATH 220, MATH 221, MATH 234.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: One of MATH 220, MATH 221, MATH 234.
